Tom Thumb (tom-thumb.bdf), a 4x6 bitmap font (3x5 usable pixels).
Original 4x6 font by Brian Swetland; modifications by Robey Pointer.
Source: https://robey.lag.net/2010/01/23/tiny-monospace-font.html

Licensed under the MIT license. Per the author's 2015 update, the font may
also be used under CC0 or CC-BY 3.0. This package uses it under CC0.
